guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: The Company is updating its full-year 2026 financial guidance as follows:

Previous Guidance | Updated Guidance
2026 Reported Revenue Change | 3.9% - 4.9% | 4.4% - 4.9%
Foreign Currency Exchange Impact | +0.5% | +0.25%
2026 Constant Currency Revenue Change | 3.4% - 4.4% | 4.1% - 4.6%
2026 Organic Constant Currency Revenue Change(1) | 2.25% - 3.25% | 3.0% - 3.5%
Adjusted Diluted EPS(2) | $8.47 - $8.59 | $8.50- $8.60

(1) | Excludes the impact of the Paragon 28 acquisition through the one-year anniversary of the acquisition date, which was approximately 110bps.
(2) | This measure is a non-GAAP financial measure for which a reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure is not available without unreasonable efforts. desk.headline: Sales up 3% to $2.06bn, adjusted EPS $1.90 in line as knees slipped; 2026 sales and EPS guidance raised
results: Net sales rose 3.1% to $2.06bn (3.7% in constant currency); US up 3.6%, international up 2.4%.
Adjusted EPS was flat at $1.90, just above the $1.89 estimate; GAAP EPS fell to $1.00 from $1.16.
Knees, the biggest product line, fell 3.1%, while hips rose 6.0%, S.E.T. (sports, trauma, foot and ankle and more) 6.8% and technology/surgical 11.9%.
Adjusted operating margin narrowed to 25.1% from 26.5% as selling costs rose.
Free cash flow rose to $372m; $579m of shares were bought back in the first nine months.

guidance.summary: Zimmer Biomet lifted its 2026 organic growth outlook and nudged up its adjusted EPS range, while trimming the expected currency benefit.

points: The CEO blamed weak knee sales on the company's own sales execution, including a switch to a dedicated sales force, and tough competition.
He rejected talk of a wider knee market slowdown, citing steady pricing, stable cancellations and growth in outpatient surgery centres.
Zimmer plans to seek FDA clearance for a fully autonomous version of its Monogram knee robot, aiming to launch in the first half of 2027.
Faster-growing lines, about two-thirds of sales, were presented as proof the push to diversify is working.
call.source: Coverage of the 4 Nov 2026 call: MedTech Dive (4 Nov 2026); Becker's Spine Review (4 Nov 2026)

watch: Whether knee sales recover as the new US sales structure settles in.
Progress on the autonomous Monogram robot filing and 2027 launch.
Pressure on margins from higher selling costs.
